description: Audit completeness, input validation, DSAR export completeness, KMS hygiene, and live-DB institution-scope test coverage: write-audit for referral/accommodation-plan/counselling-session updates and break-glass approve/deny (PRC-M519 + PRC-L115 deduped), UUID/calendar/vitals validation (PRC-L316), pagination bounds (PRC-L114), DSAR export completeness (PRC-M275), local-stub and real-KMS warning logs (PRC-M517, PRC-L313), and a live-Postgres institution-scope isolation test (PRC-L563). Depends on FEAT-001 landing first: item touches approve/deny (shared with PRC-L113) and assumes FEAT-001's write-gate helper and screening-program signature changes are already in place.
steps: PRC-M519/L115 (9a — store restructuring): in packages/backend/health/src/pg-counselling-store.ts's update() and packages/backend/health/src/pg-special-needs-store.ts's updateReferral()/updateAccommodationPlan(), wrap the UPDATE ... RETURNING * in the store's existing withTenant/withPgTenant closure (the same shape create() already uses in each store) and add a 4th parameter options?: { appendAuditInTxn?: (client: PgQueryable, entity: X) => Promise<void> }. After mapping the returned row to an entity inside the closure, call options?.appendAuditInTxn?.(client, entity) before returning — mirroring create()'s existing pattern verbatim.

PRC-M519/L115 (9b — thread options through service + repository + break-glass store): add options?: { appendAuditInTxn?: ... } to HealthRepository.updateReferral/updateAccommodationPlan/updateCounsellingSession in packages/backend/health/src/health-repository.ts, and to HealthService.updateReferral/updateAccommodationPlan/updateCounsellingSession in health-service.ts, forwarding to the repository call. Add an options parameter to PgBreakGlassStore.approve/deny in pg-break-glass-store.ts (same file touched by FEAT-001's L113 fix — do not conflict with it; approve/deny already throw BreakGlassNotPendingError from FEAT-001, add the appendAuditInTxn call after a successful state transition, before returning) and to HealthService.approveBreakGlass/denyBreakGlass, forwarding to repo.approveBreakGlassGrant/denyBreakGlassGrant.

PRC-M519/L115 (9c — route binders): in packages/backend/health/src/routes.ts, add buildReferralAuditBinder(request, tenantId, 'UPDATE'), buildAccommodationPlanAuditBinder(request, tenantId, 'UPDATE'), buildCounsellingSessionAuditBinder(request, tenantId, 'UPDATE') calls to the three existing update routes (these binder-builder functions already exist for create — reuse them with operation:'UPDATE'). Add a new buildBreakGlassAuditBinder(request, tenantId, operation) function mirroring the existing per-entity binder builders (path: '/api/v1/health/break-glass', regulated: 'health.break_glass', idField: 'breakGlassId') and use it in the approveBreakGlass/denyBreakGlass routes. Leave buildPhiWriteAuditBinder's 'anonymous' actor-fallback logic as-is (legitimate last resort, not expanding L115's scope to full before/after payload values — that is explicitly deferred/PARTIAL for this batch).

PRC-M519/L115 test: extend packages/backend/health/src/phi-write-txn-audit.test.ts (or the counselling/special-needs/break-glass sibling W1-SEC-10 test files) with cases proving updateReferral/updateAccommodationPlan/updateCounsellingSession/approveBreakGlass/denyBreakGlass each invoke appendAuditInTxn exactly once with the correct entity id when an audit binder option is supplied (failing-first against the pre-9a/9b/9c signatures).

Update packages/backend/health/src/in-memory-repository.ts and create-health-repository.ts to accept (and may no-op) the new options parameter on updateReferral/updateAccommodationPlan/updateCounsellingSession so they still satisfy the HealthRepository interface and typecheck passes.

PRC-L316 (10a — FK UUID pattern): in packages/backend/health/src/schemas.ts, add the UUID pattern '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' (same one used by UuidParamsSchema/StudentParamsSchema) to every body-level FK-id field: studentId across all Create*Schema (measurements, allergies, conditions, vaccinations, insurance, assessments, diagnoses, referrals, accommodation plans, counselling sessions, break-glass request), diagnosisId (referral/accommodation-plan schemas), counsellorId (counselling schemas), assessmentId if present.

PRC-L316 (10a test): add to packages/backend/health/src/routes.test.ts: POST to a representative create route (measurements) with studentId:'not-a-uuid' must return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (failing-first). Cover at least one route per FK-id family (measurements for studentId, referrals for diagnosisId, counselling for counsellorId) — not exhaustive across all ~10.

PRC-L316 (10b — calendar validation, the largest sub-fix): add a shared helper assertValidCalendarDate(value: string, fieldName: string, options?: { allowFuture?: boolean; minYear?: number }): void in health-service.ts (near the existing incidentAt bounds-check precedent in createNurseIncident), rejecting non-calendar dates (verify what new Date('2024-13-45') actually does in this runtime during implementation — adjust to explicit month/day range checks if Date parsing is too lenient), a minYear floor (default 1900), and future dates unless allowFuture is passed. Call it from createMeasurement/updateMeasurement (date), createAllergy/updateAllergy (diagnosedDate), createCondition/updateCondition (diagnosedDate), createVaccination/updateVaccination (dateAdministered, nextDueDate), createInsurance/updateInsurance (startDate, endDate), createAssessment (assessmentDate), createDiagnosis (diagnosisDate), createReferral/updateReferral (referralDate, appointmentDate), createAccommodationPlan/updateAccommodationPlan (startDate, endDate, reviewDate), createCounsellingSession/updateCounsellingSession (sessionDate, followUpDate).

PRC-L316 (10b test): add to health-service.test.ts or a new health-date-validation.test.ts: service.createMeasurement with date:'2024-13-45' must throw BusinessRuleError (failing-first). Cover 2-3 representative entities (measurement, vaccination's two date fields, counselling's sessionDate), not all 14 fields exhaustively.

PRC-L316 (10c — vitals upper bounds): in schemas.ts, add maximum bounds to CreateMeasurementSchema/UpdateMeasurementSchema's height (300), weight (500), bmi (100), bloodPressureSystolic/bloodPressureDiastolic (300), heartRate (300).
PRC-L316 (10c test): add to routes.test.ts: POST to /measurements with heartRate:99999 must return 400 (failing-first).

PRC-L114: in routes.ts, import resolvePaginationQuery from @proctira/validation and replace every inline `{ page: Number(query.page) || 1, pageSize: Number(query.pageSize) || 20 }` with a call to resolvePaginationQuery(request.query as Record<string, unknown>), returning 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when result.success is false, else using result.data — across all ~10 list routes (measurements, allergies, conditions, vaccinations, insurance, assessments, diagnoses, referrals, accommodation plans, counselling sessions) plus the screening-programs list route. Leave DSAR export's internal hardcoded page/pageSize untouched (not a client-supplied query param).

PRC-L114 test: add to routes.test.ts: GET .../measurements/student/:id?pageSize=99999 must return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (failing-first — currently silently accepted); repeat for ?page=-1. Cover 2-3 representative routes, not all ~10.

PRC-M275 (12a — missing sections): in health-service.ts's exportStudentDsarPackage, add a nurseIncidents section via this.repository.listNurseIncidentsByStudent?.(tenantId, studentId) ?? [] (this method already exists per-student in HealthRepository — confirm its exact signature in health-repository.ts before wiring), and a phiAccessHistory section via a direct repository call (cast to PhiAccessCapableRepository).listPhiAccessLogs?.(tenantId, { studentId }) ?? [] — call the repository method directly, NOT through the service's role-gated listPhiAccessLogs wrapper, since that wrapper enforces a stricter PHI_ACCESS_LOG_ROLES clearance than DSAR export needs (DSAR access is already checked via assertHealthAccess at the top of the method).

PRC-M275 (12b — remove the 100-row cap): add a private helper fetchAllPages<T>(lister: (page: PaginationOptions) => Promise<PaginatedResult<T>>, pageSize = 100): Promise<T[]> in health-service.ts that loops calling lister({ page: n, pageSize }), accumulating result.data, until result.data.length < pageSize. Replace the single page:{page:1,pageSize:100} + one-shot Promise.all in exportStudentDsarPackage with fetchAllPages wrapping each of the 10 existing list calls.

PRC-M275 test: add a new packages/backend/health/src/dsar-export.test.ts (or extend health-service.test.ts): (a) seed >100 measurements for a student via the in-memory repository and assert exportStudentDsarPackage returns all of them, not capped at 100 (failing-first); (b) assert the returned sections object has nurseIncidents and phiAccessHistory keys populated with the student's actual records (failing-first — keys currently absent).

PRC-M517: add a loud console.warn in packages/backend/health/src/phi-envelope.ts's assertPhiEnvelopeConfigured (in the allowed-path branch when isProductionEnv(env) && kind==='local-stub' && the ALLOW_PHI_KMS_STUB flag IS set, i.e. it does not throw) AND in packages/backend/health/src/aws-kms-phi-client.ts's createPhiKmsClientFromEnv (inside the clientMode==='local-stub' branch, right before returning LocalStubPhiKmsClient, when isProductionEnv(env) is true) — both call sites independently, since they are reached via different env-var combinations (PHI_ENVELOPE_PROVIDER=local-stub vs PHI_KMS_CLIENT=local-stub). Do not change any gating logic or make the stub secret non-deterministic.

PRC-M517 test: add one failing-first test per call site — in phi-envelope.test.ts, spy on console.warn with NODE_ENV=production + ALLOW_PHI_KMS_STUB=1 + PHI_ENVELOPE_PROVIDER=local-stub and assert it was called when assertPhiEnvelopeConfigured/createPhiEnvelopeProvider runs. In aws-kms-phi-client.test.ts, spy on console.warn with PHI_ENVELOPE_PROVIDER=kms + PHI_KMS_CLIENT=local-stub + ALLOW_PHI_KMS_STUB=1 + NODE_ENV=production and assert it was called when createPhiKmsClientFromEnv runs.

PRC-L313 (codeable slice only — root-key hot-refresh is NEEDS_DECISION, do not implement): in aws-kms-phi-client.ts's real-AWS branch of createPhiKmsClientFromEnv, add a console.warn when none of PHI_KMS_REGION/AWS_REGION/AWS_DEFAULT_REGION is set and the code falls back to 'us-east-1'. Add a small local parsePositiveIntEnv(name, env, fallback): number helper: parse PHI_KMS_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3), PHI_KMS_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS (default 3000), PHI_KMS_SOCKET_TIMEOUT_MS (default 8000) — if the env var is set but Number(...) is NaN, <=0, or non-finite, throw PhiEnvelopeMisconfiguredError naming the offending var (fail loud, do not silently fall back). Pass maxAttempts and a requestHandler: new NodeHttpHandler({ connectionTimeout, socketTimeout }) to new sdk.KMSClient({ region, maxAttempts, requestHandler }) — import NodeHttpHandler from whichever package the installed @aws-sdk/client-kms version re-exports it from (@aws-sdk/node-http-handler or @smithy/node-http-handler; confirm after pnpm install). Add a code comment near activeProvider/unwrapRootKey in phi-envelope.ts documenting that key rotation currently requires a process restart (no hot-reload) and that this is a NEEDS_DECISION item for the PR body.

PRC-L313 test: extend aws-kms-phi-client.test.ts using its existing dynamic-import mocking pattern: (a) assert KMSClient is constructed with maxAttempts:3 and a requestHandler by default; (b) assert a warning log fires when region env vars are all unset; (c) assert PHI_KMS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='abc' throws PhiEnvelopeMisconfiguredError (regression test, not failing-first — this is new validation).

PRC-L563: add a new packages/backend/health/src/pg-institution-scope.test.ts, gated it.skipIf(!isPgPhiEnabled()) matching the existing live-test pattern in pg-phi-store.test.ts. Creates two institutions in the same tenant, two students via ensurePgTestStudent each enrolled (INSERT INTO enrollments, status 'ENROLLED', exited_at IS NULL) at a different institution, creates a measurement/allergy for each via the live PgPhiStore, builds a school_nurse HealthAccessContext scoped to institution A (via authoritativeInstitutionIds:[institutionA], simplest, or by seeding staff_assignments per the pattern in packages/backend/staff/src/prisma-assignment-nullable.live.test.ts and letting findActorInstitutionAssignments resolve it live), and asserts HealthService.getMeasurement/listAllergiesByStudent for student A's record succeeds while the same call for student B's record (different institution) throws ForbiddenError. Before running: confirm the live-Postgres container is reachable (docker ps --filter name=proctira-erp-postgres-1) and run migrations first (DATABASE_URL=postgresql://proctira:proctira_dev_password@localhost:5434/proctira pnpm --filter @proctira/database run prisma:migrate:deploy). If the container is unreachable, state that explicitly in findings — the test must still be correctly gated so it skips cleanly without DATABASE_URL, rather than fabricating a pass.
Run pnpm install at the worktree root first if node_modules is still empty (should already be done by FEAT-001, but re-check).
acceptance_criteria: updateReferral/updateAccommodationPlan/updateCounsellingSession/approveBreakGlass/denyBreakGlass each invoke appendAuditInTxn exactly once with the correct entity id when a binder is supplied.
POST with a non-UUID studentId/diagnosisId/counsellorId body field returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR for at least one representative route per FK-id family.
POST with an invalid calendar date (e.g. 2024-13-45) is rejected with BusinessRuleError for at least 3 representative date fields across different entities.
POST with heartRate:99999 (or another out-of-bound vital) returns 400.
GET list routes with pageSize=99999 or page=-1 return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR for at least 2-3 representative routes.
exportStudentDsarPackage returns ALL of a student's records for a section with >100 rows (not capped at 100), and includes nurseIncidents + phiAccessHistory keys.
A console.warn fires at both independent local-stub-KMS-in-production call sites (assertPhiEnvelopeConfigured and createPhiKmsClientFromEnv).
KMSClient is constructed with explicit maxAttempts and a timeout-configured requestHandler; a malformed PHI_KMS_MAX_ATTEMPTS throws PhiEnvelopeMisconfiguredError instead of silently producing NaN.
The new pg-institution-scope.test.ts either runs green against a live DB or skips cleanly without DATABASE_URL — findings records which occurred.
pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-health test passes in full; pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-health run typecheck passes.
verification: pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-health test -- pg-institution-scope (conditional on a reachable live DB; otherwise confirm it skips cleanly)
findings:
All steps implemented. PRC-M519/L115: pg-counselling-store.ts's update() and pg-special-needs-store.ts's updateReferral()/updateAccommodationPlan() were restructured into the same single withPgTenant closure create() uses (SELECT+UPDATE+appendAuditInTxn share one COMMIT); pg-break-glass-store.ts's approve()/deny() gained a 4th `options` param and call appendAuditInTxn after the UPDATE succeeds, building on top of FEAT-001's BreakGlassNotPendingError throw unchanged (no conflict). HealthRepository/HealthService/HybridHealthRepository signatures threaded through for all five; in-memory-repository.ts accepts-and-ignores the new options param on updateReferral/updateAccommodationPlan/updateCounsellingSession (matching every existing create*() method's established in-memory convention of never invoking appendAuditInTxn, since there is no real client/transaction) and still throws BreakGlassNotPendingError on approveBreakGlassGrant/denyBreakGlassGrant for an already-resolved grant. routes.ts: added UPDATE-operation audit binders to the three update routes and a new buildBreakGlassAuditBinder (path '/api/v1/health/break-glass', regulated 'health.break_glass', idField 'breakGlassId') wired into both approve/deny routes. New/extended tests: phi-write-txn-audit.test.ts unchanged; counselling-write-txn-audit.test.ts, special-needs-write-txn-audit.test.ts, break-glass-write-txn-audit.test.ts each gained update/approve/deny appendAuditInTxn cases.

PRC-L316: added the shared UUID_PATTERN const to schemas.ts and applied it to every body-level FK-id field (studentId across all Create*Schema including the break-glass request schema, diagnosisId, counsellorId, assessmentId). Added `assertValidCalendarDate(value, fieldName, {allowFuture, minYear})` (exported from health-service.ts) using explicit year/month/day range checks (via `new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate()` for days-in-month, leap-year-correct) rather than trusting `new Date(...)` parsing — confirmed Node's Date silently rolls '2024-02-30' forward to March 1 rather than rejecting it, and the schema's digit-only regex accepts '2024-13-45'. Wired into every create/update method with 14 date fields across 8 entities; future-date rejection defaults on, overridden with allowFuture:true for forward-looking fields (nextDueDate, insurance dates, appointmentDate, accommodation-plan dates, followUpDate). Added maximum bounds to CreateMeasurementSchema/UpdateMeasurementSchema vitals (height 300, weight 500, bmi 100, both BP fields 300, heartRate 300). New test file health-date-validation.test.ts (10 tests: unit tests for the helper + 3 wired-in service tests) plus UUID/vitals-bound tests added to routes.test.ts.

PRC-L114: added `resolveListPagination(request)` helper in routes.ts wrapping @proctira/validation's resolvePaginationQuery; replaced the inline `{page: Number(query.page)||1, pageSize: Number(query.pageSize)||20}` at all 10 list routes plus the screening-programs list route (which also needed its gradeLevel query-param destructuring split out). DSAR export's internal pagination (now removed entirely, see M275) was never a client-facing query param so there was nothing to touch there. Added 3 failing-first tests to routes.test.ts (pageSize=99999 and page=-1 on measurements, pageSize=99999 on counselling sessions).

PRC-M275: added a private `fetchAllPages<T>(lister, pageSize=100)` helper on HealthService that loops until a page returns fewer than pageSize rows, replacing the one-shot `{page:1, pageSize:100}` + Promise.all in exportStudentDsarPackage — this removes the former 100-row cap on all 10 existing sections. Added nurseIncidents (via `this.repository.listNurseIncidentsByStudent?.()`) and phiAccessHistory (via a direct `repo.listPhiAccessLogs?.(tenantId, {studentId})` call, deliberately bypassing the role-gated `listPhiAccessLogs` wrapper per the step's instruction, since DSAR access is already checked via assertHealthAccess at the top of the method) as two new sections. New test file dsar-export.test.ts: one test seeds 120 measurements and asserts all are returned; one test asserts nurseIncidents/phiAccessHistory keys are present and populated with the student's actual records.

PRC-M517: added two independent `console.warn('PRC-M517: ...')` call sites as specified. (1) phi-envelope.ts's assertPhiEnvelopeConfigured, placed immediately after the existing ALLOW_PHI_KMS_STUB=1-in-production branch that intentionally does not throw — reached via PHI_ENVELOPE_PROVIDER=local-stub. (2) aws-kms-phi-client.ts's createPhiKmsClientFromEnv, inside the PHI_KMS_CLIENT=local-stub branch, guarded by isProductionEnv(env) (imported from phi-envelope.ts) — reached via the separate PHI_KMS_CLIENT=local-stub env-var combo, independent of (1). Tests: phi-envelope.test.ts's case spies on console.warn and asserts the 'PRC-M517' substring under NODE_ENV=production + ALLOW_PHI_KMS_STUB=1 + PHI_ENVELOPE_PROVIDER=local-stub; aws-kms-phi-client.test.ts's new case does the same for PHI_ENVELOPE_PROVIDER=kms + PHI_KMS_CLIENT=local-stub + ALLOW_PHI_KMS_STUB=1 + NODE_ENV=production, per the step's exact spec.

PRC-L313 (codeable slice only, root-key hot-refresh NOT implemented — see NEEDS_DECISION below): added `parsePositiveIntEnv(name, env, fallback)` in aws-kms-phi-client.ts that throws PhiEnvelopeMisconfiguredError naming the offending var when set-but-NaN/<=0/non-finite; used for PHI_KMS_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3), PHI_KMS_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS (default 3000), PHI_KMS_SOCKET_TIMEOUT_MS (default 8000). Added a console.warn when none of PHI_KMS_REGION/AWS_REGION/AWS_DEFAULT_REGION is set before falling back to 'us-east-1'. Constructs `new sdk.KMSClient({region, maxAttempts, requestHandler: new NodeHttpHandler({connectionTimeout, socketTimeout})})`. IMPORTANT DEPENDENCY CHANGE: @smithy/node-http-handler was present only as a *transitive* dependency nested inside @aws-sdk/client-kms's own node_modules (pnpm's strict linking does not expose it to health's own imports) — added `"@smithy/node-http-handler": "4.12.1"` (exact-pinned, matching the already-resolved transitive version) as a direct dependency in packages/backend/health/package.json and ran `pnpm install --filter @proctira/backend-health` to update node_modules/lockfile. This is a medium-risk, scoped dependency addition (one new direct dep, exact version, same major/minor already in the dependency tree) — flagging per policy even though it was necessary to satisfy the FEAT step's explicit instruction to import NodeHttpHandler. Tests added to aws-kms-phi-client.test.ts: (a) KMSClient constructed with maxAttempts:3 + requestHandler by default (via the existing dynamic-import mocking pattern, vi.doMock + vi.resetModules), (b) warning fires when all three region env vars are unset, (c) PHI_KMS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='abc' throws PhiEnvelopeMisconfiguredError.

NEEDS_DECISION (not implemented, flagging for PR body per task instructions): PRC-L313's broader root-key hot-refresh scope. Added a code comment directly above `activeProvider` in phi-envelope.ts documenting that `ensurePhiEnvelopeProvider` resolves and caches the provider once at boot with no hot-reload path — rotating PHI_KMS_WRAPPED_ROOT_KEY or bumping PHI_KMS_KEY_VERSION today requires a process restart. Whether to add a hot-refresh path (and its blast radius on in-flight encrypt/decrypt calls using a root key that is about to be rotated out) is a product/ops decision, not implemented here.

PRC-L563: wrote packages/backend/health/src/pg-institution-scope.test.ts, gated `it.skipIf(!isPgPhiEnabled())` matching the existing live-test pattern. Verified the live-Postgres container (`proctira-erp-postgres-1`, port 5434) is up and reachable via `docker ps` and `psql SELECT 1`. Ran `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://proctira:proctira_dev_password@localhost:5434/proctira pnpm --filter @proctira/database run prisma:migrate:deploy` against the worktree's own designated scratch DB (`proctira`) and it failed with the EXACT SAME pre-existing P3009 error FEAT-001 already documented (migration `20260908_wave7_rls_hardening` fails: `relation "attendance_audit" does not exist`) — confirmed independently, not a regression from this FEAT, and unrelated to health. Without DATABASE_URL set, the new test (and the other 5 pre-existing it.skipIf(!isPgXEnabled()) live suites) skip cleanly — confirmed via `pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-health test` (the package's default/documented test command omits DATABASE_URL). HOWEVER: this session's shell also had an ambient DATABASE_URL pointing at a *different*, already-migrated scratch database (`proctira_institution_batch`, apparently left set by a concurrent/prior session in this same host) — running `pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-health test` with that ambient value picked up live and actually EXECUTED the new test (plus all 5 pre-existing live pg-*.test.ts suites) against a real migrated Postgres instance, green: 'PgPhiStore', 'PgCounsellingStore', 'PgSpecialNeedsStore', 'PgNurseIncidentStore', and the new 'PRC-L563' suite all passed (208/208 tests, 0 skipped) in that run. So the live-DB test ACTUALLY RAN AND PASSED against a real migrated database during this session, not merely 'skipped cleanly' — but that database was not one this FEAT provisioned or was instructed to use; it was incidental ambient environment state. FEAT-003 should NOT assume that ambient DATABASE_URL will be present in its own shell — treat it as not reliably available and verify independently before trusting a 'live DB ran' claim. The test itself seeds its own institutions/students/enrollments per the `pg-enrollment-uniqueness.live.test.ts` pattern (geographic_areas -> institutions -> academic_periods -> grades -> classes -> students -> enrollments) and uses the simplest HealthAccessContext shape the task brief allowed (`authoritativeInstitutionIds: [institutionA]`) rather than seeding staff_assignments and exercising findActorInstitutionAssignments live.

Deviations from the plan: none that changed scope. One correction during implementation: my first attempt at in-memory-repository.ts's updateReferral/updateAccommodationPlan/updateCounsellingSession/approveBreakGlassGrant/denyBreakGlassGrant WAS invoking appendAuditInTxn with a fake `{}` client object — this broke routes.test.ts's break-glass approve test (TypeError: client.query is not a function, since buildPhiWriteAuditBinder's appendAuditInTxn calls appendAuditEntryOnClient(client, ...) which calls client.query). Caught this via the full test suite failing, diagnosed the root cause (I had deviated from every existing create*() method's established in-memory convention of accepting-and-ignoring the options param), and reverted to the established pattern (`_options?:` prefix, never invoked) rather than patching around it.

Final test count added by this FEAT's new test files: health-date-validation.test.ts (10), dsar-export.test.ts (2), pg-institution-scope.test.ts (1), plus extensions to existing files: counselling-write-txn-audit.test.ts (+2), special-needs-write-txn-audit.test.ts (+3), break-glass-write-txn-audit.test.ts (+3), phi-envelope.test.ts (+1), aws-kms-phi-client.test.ts (+4), routes.test.ts (+7). Full `pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-health test` (no DATABASE_URL): 201 passed, 7 skipped (208 total). `pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-health run typecheck`: 0 errors. eslint on every touched .ts file: 0 errors, pre-existing warning patterns only (require-await on in-memory repo methods, hardcoded-i18n-message on routes.ts's pre-existing 'Tenant context is required' strings — none introduced by this FEAT's new code paths, i.e. the one new string 'Invalid pagination parameters' triggers the same pre-existing warning class). prettier --check: clean after one --write pass to fix formatting on 5 files.
